'''Shell''' was a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who, along with [[Deke (slicer)|Deke]], sliced into a [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] database in the [[Pawalo District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Marcham Prace]] was aware of the crime, having placed a tracker on Deke. Shell was stunned and arrested, and the data she stole recovered.<ref name="CTD" />
